WITH clientes AS (
    SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS ordenes
    FROM v_orders
    WHERE order_status = 4
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
tiendas AS (
    SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS ordenes
    FROM v_orders
    WHERE order_status = 4
    GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT tienda, ordenes, ROUND(SUM(net_total), 2) AS ticket_promedio
FROM (
    SELECT tienda, ordenes, net_total
    FROM (
        SELECT tienda, ordenes, net_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tienda ORDER BY net_total DESC) AS row_num
        FROM (
            SELECT tienda, ordenes, net_total
            FROM (
                SELECT tienda, customer_id, COUNT(*) AS ordenes, SUM(net_total) AS net_total
                FROM v_orders
                WHERE order_status = 4
                GROUP BY tienda, customer_id
            ) AS subquery
            JOIN (
                SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS ordenes, SUM(net_total) AS net_total
                FROM v_orders
                WHERE order_status = 4
                GROUP BY customer_id
            ) AS subquery2
            ON subquery.customer_id = subquery2.customer_id
        ) AS subquery3
    ) AS subquery4
    JOIN (
        SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS ordenes, SUM(net_total) AS net_total
        FROM v_orders
        WHERE order_status = 4
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) AS subquery5
    ON subquery4.customer_id = subquery5.customer_id
    WHERE subquery5.customer_id = subquery4.customer_id
    AND subquery5.customer_id = subquery3.customer_id
    AND subquery5.customer_id = subquery2.customer_id
    AND subquery5.customer_id = subquery1.customer_id
